newsitem.title: GERMANY: HANNOVER RE SEEKING TO ACQUIRE UNIORIAS - SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: HANNOVER RE SEEKING TO ACQUIRE UNIORIAS - SOURCES.

text.p: German reinsurer Hannover Rueckversicherung is seeking to acquire Italy's largest reinsurance company Unione Italiana di Riassicurazioni (Uniorias), Rome, according to German insurance sources.
Hannover Re is negotiating with Italian insurer Istituto Nazionale di Assicurazioni (INA) over the acquisition of the Uniorias majority. INA owns 97.99 percent of the shares.

But so far, Hannover Re's offer and the price asked by INA are comparatively far apart, the sources said. Hannover Re was also not necessarily interested in all of Uniorias' activities. But despite differences talks were continuing, the sources said.

Hannover Re, which is controlled by German mutual insurer Haftpflichtverband der Deutschen Industrie (HDI), Hanover, said it would not comment. But the company did not deny that talks were being held.

With gross premium income of 5.999 billion marks in 1995, the Hannover Re group is one of the five largest reinsurers in the world. Uniorias reported for 1995 gross income of 1,504 billion lira, 7.1 percent up on the 1,404 bn lira of 1994. INA announced publicly its intention to sell the reinsurer, as it does not regard reinsurance as part of its core activities. --Reuters Insurance News +44 171 542 2770
